# Chapter 09 · Exact Inference in Linear Regression {.unnumbered}
*$t$ Test · $F$ Test · Confidence Sets · Economic Significance*

sampling distribution에서 hypothesis, size·power, exact $t$·$F$ test, confidence interval·region으로 이어지는 linear regression의 finite-sample inference를 정리합니다.

## Chapter Map

::: {.callout-note title="Reading Roadmap"}
- **9.1–9.3** inference의 기본 언어: hypothesis, rejection region, size, power
- **9.4–9.7** single restriction $t$-test, $p$-value, confidence interval, $F$-test
- **9.8–9.11** restricted LS, joint uncertainty, economic interpretation, asymptotics의 필요성
- **9.12** 요약과 연습문제
:::
